per_skip.candidate: Single exon 55 skip (brief's stated goal; frame-invalid per enumeration)
per_skip.target_evidence: n/a (canonical exon, splice sites intact). Enumeration is decisive: exon 55 = 190 bp, frame remainder 1, so the 54|56 junction is out of frame.
per_skip.published_asos: Yes. Wilton et al. 2007 built AOs against every human DMD exon except the first and last, and every targeted exon could be removed (PMID 17285139). Specific exon-55 oligos retrieved: H55A(-10+20), a 2'-O-methyl AO annealing to the last 10 nt of intron 54 + first 20 nt of exon 55, reported to give dose-dependent exon 55 skipping (US9758783B2); and the PMO Ex55_Ac0 30-mer TCTTCCAAAGCAGCCTCTCGCTCACTCACC, sitting on the exon 55 acceptor, used in the Yokota-lab 45-55 cocktails (PMC6838919, PMC5957359).
per_skip.coordinated_skipping: Relevant in reverse: an AO directed to exon 54 removes exons 54+55 together, so a 54-directed oligo is a better route to the in-frame product than an exon-55 oligo. No report found of an exon-55-directed oligo also removing 54 or 56. Searches: PubMed 'DMD exon 55 antisense oligonucleotide skipping', 'double exon skipping single antisense oligonucleotide dystrophin two adjacent exons' (0 hits); web 'single antisense oligonucleotide induced skipping of two adjacent dystrophin exons'; Europe PMC unavailable (HTTP 503 on three attempts).
per_skip.linked_or_multitarget: Brogidirsen (NS-089/NCNP-02) is a single PMO molecule containing two linked sequences against two separate sites in exon 44 — direct precedent for putting two binding arms in one oligo (PMID 40725431, NCT05996003).
per_skip.amenability: Exon 55 is amenable at the acceptor site (H55A(-10+20) and Ex55_Ac0 both target -10/0 relative to the 3' splice site). Algorithmic skipping-efficiency score for Ex55_Ac0 was 120.4% — a software prediction, not a measurement; the measured cell-based readout reported was simply >20% individual skipping at 5-10 uM. No endogenous single exon-55 skipping was detected in the one study that systematically looked for endogenous skipping around this hotspot (PMC5085753).

findings.claim: AO panel covering every human DMD exon except first and last; every targeted exon could be removed, some more efficiently than others.
H55A(-10+20) anneals to last 10 bases of intron 54 and first 20 of exon 55 and induced dose-dependent exon 55 skipping.
PMO Ex55_Ac0 (TCTTCCAAAGCAGCCTCTCGCTCACTCACC) targets the exon 55 acceptor; predicted efficiency 120.4%.
Single exon 55 skipping is theoretically applicable to 1.8% of all DMD mutations, 3.7% of deletions.

per_skip.candidate: Double skip of exons 54-55 (lead: 345 bp, -115 aa, 53|56 junction)
per_skip.target_evidence: n/a — both exons canonical with intact splice sites. Protein-level validation is the gap: the UMD-DMD analysis lists '54 & 55' as a double-skip strategy but supplies no phenotype data for patients carrying that in-frame deletion (PMC11593839). I found no del54-55 Becker case report. Searches: web 'DMD in-frame deletion exons 54-55 Becker phenotype', 'dystrophin deletion exons 54-55 patient Becker mild phenotype Leiden DMD database'. Nearest proxies: ~90% of del45-55 patients (75/83) are BMD not DMD (PMC6313462), and a CRISPR Dmd del52-55 mouse made near-normal muscle/heart when young but was not protected against exercise damage at 52 weeks (PMC12519546).
per_skip.published_asos: Exon 54: H54A(+67+97), reported to give strong and consistent exon 54 skipping (US9758783B2); PMO Ex54_Ac42 30-mer GAGAAGTTTCAGGGCCAAGTCATTTGCCAC, 42 nt into the exon from the acceptor, predicted 62.0% (PMC6838919, PMC5957359). Exon 55: H55A(-10+20) and Ex55_Ac0 (see above). All four are off-the-shelf starting sequences; no published oligo or cocktail has been reported as deliberately aimed at a del54-55 product.
per_skip.coordinated_skipping: YES — the strongest finding in this report. Adams/Fletcher/Wilton: 'Targeting human or canine dystrophin exon 8 always leads to transcripts missing exons 8 and 9, whereas directing AOs to human exons 17, 34 or 54 induces transcripts missing the targeted exon as well as 17+18, 34+35 and 54+55 respectively' (PMC1933433). Independently restated by Mitrpant et al.: 'directing an AO to human dystrophin exon 54 led to removal of both exons 54 + 55', citing Wilton 2007 (PMC2835229, PMID 17285139). A web snippet of the primary source describes exon-54 targeting giving exon-54-only and exon-54+55 transcripts in roughly equal amounts; I could not open Wilton 2007 full text (Cell Press 403) to confirm that quantification, so treat the ratio as unverified. Caveat: the same patent that lists H54A(+67+97) describes it only as 'strong and consistent exon 54 skipping' with no mention of exon 55, so co-skipping may be oligo- or site-dependent and must be re-measured per candidate oligo.
per_skip.linked_or_multitarget: Brogidirsen: one PMO with two linked sequences to two sites in exon 44; mean dystrophin 20.55% of normal (24.47% in cohort 2) in Phase 1/2, 4.5-year extension data presented at MDA 2026 (PMID 40725431, NCT05996003). Yokota-lab cocktails routinely co-administer 2-11 separate PMOs (PMC6838919). Exon 48 needed two different PMOs to skip well in that screen — precedent that one exon may demand two arms.
per_skip.amenability: Both exons are reachable at their 3' splice sites/early exonic ESEs; published oligos exist for each. Mechanistically exons 54 and 55 behave as a coupled splicing unit in human pre-mRNA (exon-54 targeting pulls exon 55 out with it), which is exactly what this block needs and makes it the most 'exon-definition-friendly' of the in-frame options. No endogenous 54+55 skipping was reported: the only systematic endogenous study found eight multi-exon-skipped species around the hotspot, the ideal exon44-56 (i.e. 45-55 skipped) species at ~600-fold lower abundance than full-length mRNA, and it could not resolve short/single skips (PMC5085753). So there is no meaningful baseline to build on — the event must be driven.

findings.claim: AOs to human exon 54 induce transcripts missing exon 54 as well as exons 54+55.
'directing an AO to human dystrophin exon 54 led to removal of both exons 54 + 55'.
H54A(+67+97) gave strong and consistent exon 54 skipping; H56A(+92+121) strong consistent exon 56 skipping.
PMO Ex54_Ac42 = GAGAAGTTTCAGGGCCAAGTCATTTGCCAC, predicted efficiency 62.0%; individual skipping exceeded 20% at 5-10 uM.
Exon 54&55 double skipping is applicable to 0.7% of all mutations / 2.0% of deletions; no phenotype data given for the resulting in-frame deletion.
~90% of patients with a del45-55 in-frame deletion (75/83) have BMD rather than DMD.

per_skip.candidate: Double skip of exons 55-56 (co-lead: 363 bp, -121 aa, 54|57 junction)
per_skip.target_evidence: n/a — canonical exons. Protein validation equally absent: UMD-DMD lists '55 & 56' at 0.6% of all mutations / 2.0% of deletions with no phenotype data for the in-frame del55-56 genotype (PMC11593839). Searches as above found no del55-56 Becker case report.
per_skip.published_asos: Exon 55: H55A(-10+20) (US9758783B2) and Ex55_Ac0 PMO (PMC6838919). Exon 56: H56A(+92+121), reported to give strong and consistent exon 56 skipping (US9758783B2). Exon 56 is outside the 45-55 hotspot, so it is absent from the Yokota PMO cocktail tables — fewer validated starting sequences than for exon 54.
per_skip.coordinated_skipping: None found. The published coupling reports in human DMD are 8+9, 17+18, 34+35 and 54+55 (PMC1933433); exon 55/56 is not among them, and nothing indicates an exon-55 oligo pulls exon 56 out or vice versa. Searches: PubMed 'dystrophin exon 54 exon 56 antisense oligonucleotide skipping efficiency' (0 hits), 'double exon skipping single antisense oligonucleotide dystrophin two adjacent exons' (0 hits); web '"exon 56" dystrophin antisense oligonucleotide skipping efficiency "exon 55" cocktail PMO', 'single antisense oligonucleotide induced skipping of two adjacent dystrophin exons'; Europe PMC down (503). Assume two oligos are required.
per_skip.linked_or_multitarget: Same precedent as above (brogidirsen dual-arm single molecule; multi-PMO cocktails). A two-arm linked oligo carrying an exon-55 and an exon-56 sequence is architecturally supported by brogidirsen but has no DMD multi-exon precedent.
per_skip.amenability: Exon 55 acceptor-site targeting is documented; exon 56 has a working exonic-ESE oligo at +92+121. Neither exon shows reported endogenous skipping. Because exon 56 is not part of any coupled pair in the literature, 55-56 inherits the full multiplicative penalty of needing two independent skips in the same transcript, whereas 54-55 does not. That asymmetry, not the 6-aa difference in deleted protein, should decide the lead.

findings.claim: Exon 55&56 double skipping: 0.6% of all mutations, 2.0% of deletions; no phenotype data supplied.
Documented human DMD coupled exon pairs from single AOs are 8+9, 17+18, 34+35 and 54+55 — 55+56 is not listed.
H56A(+92+121) is a validated exon 56 skipping oligo.

per_skip.candidate: Larger in-frame blocks containing exon 55 (52-55, 54-57, 50-55, 52-57, 53-58, 54-59, up to 45-55)
per_skip.target_evidence: Endogenous multi-exon skipping at this hotspot exists but is negligible: eight MES species detected, the exon44-56 (45-55-skipped) species ~600-fold less abundant than full-length DMD mRNA (~12 extra PCR cycles) (PMC5085753). Protein validation is best for the widest block: ~90% of del45-55 patients are BMD (75/83) (PMC6313462). For 52-55 specifically, a CRISPR Dmd del52-55 mouse had wild-type-like muscle and heart histology/function when young but the truncated protein was insufficient to protect against exercise-induced damage by 52 weeks (PMC12519546).
per_skip.published_asos: Richest precedent of any candidate here. Yokota-lab mutation-tailored PMO cocktails for 45-55 include Ex53_Ac9 (GTTCTTGTACTTCATCCCACTGATTCTGAA, 73.9% predicted), Ex54_Ac42 and Ex55_Ac0 (PMC6838919, PMC5957359). In patient-derived myotubes, 45-55-skipped mRNA reached 61%, 43% and 27% with cocktails at 10 uM each PMO (PMC5957359). Bodywide 45-55 skipping was achieved in mdx52 mice with systemic antisense delivery (PMID 22869723), and in vivo single- and multi-exon skipping protocols in mdx52 are published (PMID 30171548, 40720023).
per_skip.coordinated_skipping: Only the 54+55 coupling is documented (PMC1933433, PMC2835229). Beyond that, the field's own verdict is negative: 'a technical problem in AO-mediated multiple exon skipping is the difficulty in excluding all targeted exons from a pre-mRNA at the same time', and the authors advocate cocktails rather than single-oligo coordinated skipping (PMC6313462). A 52-55 block could in principle be 3 oligos rather than 4 if the 54-directed oligo carries exon 55 along.
per_skip.linked_or_multitarget: Cocktails of 2-11 PMOs are the established architecture (PMC6838919, PMID 22869723). DG9 cell-penetrating-peptide conjugation improved exon 51 skipping and muscle function in hDMDdel52;mdx mice, and a minimized 45-55 DG9-PMO mixture restored dystrophin locally — the only route found for making a many-oligo cocktail deliverable.
per_skip.amenability: Individual exon amenability in 50-55 is good (published PMOs with measured >20% single-exon skipping at 5-10 uM); exon 53 was the weak member in one screen (only a faint band) and exon 48 needed two PMOs. Each added exon multiplies CMC, dosing and safety burden and deletes 110-485 aa more of the rod domain. Keep as fallback only if neither 54-55 nor 55-56 skips cleanly.

findings.claim: Cocktail PMOs at 10 uM each gave 45-55-skipped mRNA up to 61%, 43% and 27% in transdifferentiated DMD patient myotubes.
Endogenous exon44-56 (45-55-skipped) transcript is present at ~600-fold lower level than full-length DMD mRNA.
Dmd del52-55 mouse: truncated dystrophin maintained young muscle/heart function but did not protect against exercise damage at 52 weeks.
Bodywide skipping of exons 45-55 achieved in dystrophic mdx52 mice by systemic antisense delivery.
Exon 53 gave only a faint skipping band while exon 48 required two different PMOs; 45-55 cocktail design was mutation-tailored.

per_skip.candidate: Partial exon 55 removal via an exon-internal cryptic splice site
per_skip.target_evidence: Not demonstrated. No report found of a cryptic acceptor or donor inside DMD exon 55, let alone one at a frame-compatible distance from the PTC. Searches: web 'DMD exon 55 splice site strength exonic splicing enhancer ... cryptic', 'exon 55 DMD nonsense mutation exon skipping strategy'; PubMed 'DMD exon 55 antisense oligonucleotide skipping'; Europe PMC unavailable (503). The one systematic analysis retrieved shows cryptic-site activation is a real competing outcome in DMD but is governed by splice-site strength and ESE density rather than being individually catalogued per exon, and it is the failure mode of splice-site-masking oligos, not a designable target.
per_skip.published_asos: None found against an exon-55 internal cryptic site. The nearest analogous published work is base-editor-mediated ESE disruption for exon skipping, which reports that exons with a strong 3' splice site and high ESE density tend to show cryptic-site activation instead of clean skipping — a warning, not a precedent.
per_skip.amenability: Unassessable without a mapped cryptic site. Note the published exon-55 oligos (H55A(-10+20), Ex55_Ac0) both sit on the 3' splice site, which is precisely the configuration that can provoke cryptic acceptor use — so this outcome should be monitored as an off-target readout (the brief explicitly requires its absence) rather than pursued as a mechanism.

findings.claim: Exons showing predominantly cryptic-site activation had a strong 3' splice site and higher mean ESE motif density than exons showing clean skipping.
Interplay between DMD point mutations and splicing signals determines skipping vs cryptic-site outcomes.

per_skip.candidate: Non-frame-restoring mechanisms: NMD evasion, output-raising/poison-exon block, uORF/3'UTR or transcriptional upregulation, allele knockdown
per_skip.target_evidence: No target element retrieved for any of these in DMD, and none would help: every one of them changes the amount, stability or translation of a message that still carries the exon-55 PTC. No DMD poison exon, repressive uORF or repressive natural antisense transcript was found in the searches run ('DMD exon 55 ... skipping', 'exon skipping for nonsense mutations in DMD', UMD-DMD applicability review, endogenous MES study). The endogenous-splicing survey of this locus reported only multi-exon-skipped and back-spliced circRNA by-products, not an NMD-coupled poison exon that throttles productive output (PMC5085753).
per_skip.published_asos: None found for any of these mechanisms in DMD. Note also that no ASO mechanism induces translational readthrough of a PTC; that is small-molecule territory, so stabilising the exon-55 transcript yields only more rod-domain truncate lacking the cysteine-rich and C-terminal domains.
per_skip.amenability: Not applicable. Knockdown is actively harmful: in a hemizygous male there is no second allele to spare. These should be dropped from the program rather than carried as backups.

findings.claim: Endogenous survey of the DMD hotspot detected multi-exon-skipped transcripts and circRNA by-products, with no poison-exon/NMD-coupled regulator reported.

60% of dystrophinopathy patients in a 1,111-mutation series would be candidates for mutation-specific approaches; 294 nonsense mutations catalogued, confirming nonsense lesions need frame restoration not output increase.

per_skip.candidate: Surrogate-gene upregulation by ASO (UTRN or modifier transcripts)
per_skip.target_evidence: No specific druggable repressive element in UTRN was located in the searches run here (the retrieval budget went to the splice candidates: searches were DMD/exon-skipping focused — 'DMD exon 55 ...', 'exon skipping applicability UMD-DMD', 'multiple exon skipping hot spots'; no dedicated UTRN uORF/3'UTR/antisense search was completed). Treat the UTRN element as unlocated, not as absent.
per_skip.amenability: Unknown here. It is mutation-agnostic and therefore genuinely independent of the exon-55 PTC, but it does not address the lesion and its achievable fold-change in utrophin and mechanical benefit are not established by anything retrieved. Park it as a possible combination arm; do not let it compete for the lead.

findings.claim: No UTRN-directed ASO element evidence was retrieved in this search set; the mechanism remains unlocated rather than excluded.

benchmarks_not_transferable: Three numbers will be misread as expectations for this program. (1) Clinical single-skip dystrophin levels: brogidirsen mean 20.55% of normal (24.47% cohort 2) for exon 44 (PMID 40725431, NCT05996003) and DYNE-251 8.72% mean absolute muscle-adjusted dystrophin at 20 mg/kg Q4W (Dyne DELIVER release). Both are SINGLE-exon skips of exons with validated Becker genotypes, delivered by a dual-arm PMO or an Fc-TfR1 conjugate; they are chemistry, dosing, safety and delivery precedent only. A 54-55 or 55-56 product needs TWO exons out of the SAME transcript, so yield is multiplicative unless the 54+55 coupling does the work — the honest prior is a fraction of a single-skip number, not equal to it. (2) The 45-55 cocktail in vitro figures (61%/43%/27% skipped mRNA, PMC5957359) are transfection of immortalized or transdifferentiated patient cells with 10 uM of each of 5-6 PMOs — not a systemic-dose expectation, and measured as mRNA not protein. (3) Ex55_Ac0's '120.4%' and Ex54_Ac42's '62.0%' are outputs of the authors' predictive algorithm (PMC6838919), not measured skipping; the measured statement for those oligos is only '>20% at 5-10 uM'. Separately, the del45-55 Becker phenotype data (~90% BMD, 75/83) must not be transferred to del54-55 or del55-56: those two in-frame genotypes have NO retrieved patient phenotype data, and the del52-55 mouse shows a truncated rod-domain protein can look normal young yet fail under exercise stress at 52 weeks (PMC12519546).
proposed_designs: Lead: single PMO on exon 54 (H54A(+67+97) and Ex54_Ac42 as starting sequences) exploiting documented 54+55 coupling; one oligo, in-frame 53|56 junction.
Lead backstop: two-PMO cocktail, exon-54 ESE oligo + exon-55 acceptor oligo (Ex55_Ac0 / H55A(-10+20)), to force the del54-55 product if coupling is partial.
Parallel: dual-arm single molecule, brogidirsen-style, with linked exon-54 and exon-55 arms; one drug substance, two binding sites.
Fallback: two-PMO exon 55 + exon 56 cocktail (Ex55_Ac0 + H56A(+92+121)) for the 54|57 in-frame junction if exon 54 skips poorly.
Rescue: 3-4 PMO cocktail for the 52-55 block (Ex53_Ac9, Ex54_Ac42, Ex55_Ac0 + exon-52 oligo), DG9-peptide conjugated.
